data.body: AC amendment: Fixture schema must match real ticket CLI output shape and be version-pinned. Require (a) fixture JSON schema matches exact field names from `dso ticket list --format=llm` (specifically detected_by tag location in tags array), and (b) the fixture loader rejects fixtures with unknown top-level keys so future CLI schema changes surface as test failures rather than silent zero-count aggregation. Taxonomy: implicit_assumption.
